notes.title: Announcing PLAYISM as publisher for Dyping Escape.
notes.notes:
[p]We are excited to announce PLAYISM as publisher for Dyping Escape.    [/p][p][/p][p]Development was originally set for a July 2025 release, but following the new publishing announcement, the release period is now set for 2026 in order to further improve quality. We will be upgrading the game in order to deliver a more polished typing-based horror experience, having removed the previously planned roguelike elements.  [/p][p]Additionally, The game will be available for play at Tokyo Game Show 2025. The demo version will offer a glimpse at the core experience of this title, that of an escape room typing game filled with death.    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491620/7465cb81d157758ac5fd42b63f08723d600f7d1d.png"][/img]A key switch keychain will also be available as a play bonus. This key switch can be used with mechanical keyboards (*may not be compatible depending on design standard). We hope you'll put it to use with the official release!    We will be making further announcements via Steam news and other sources. Wishlist now to stay informed.
